summary: Deliver the primary workflow in two verified phases.

phases.title: Foundation
phases.objective: Establish contracts, persistence boundaries, and test infrastructure.
verificationStrategy: Run typecheck, lint, and unit tests

phases.title: Primary workflow
phases.objective: Implement and verify the user-facing primary workflow.

tasks.title: Implement the primary data and domain foundation
tasks.description: Create the validated domain and persistence interfaces required by the workflow.
outputs: Validated domain module and repository interfaces
tasks.repairStrategy: Fix the failing contract or domain behavior and rerun the affected test before continuing.
tasks.rollbackStrategy: Revert the additive domain module before integration.

tasks.title: Implement the primary workflow
tasks.description: Build the authenticated workflow and verify the accepted behavior.
completionCriteria: The primary workflow passes its acceptance test
tasks.repairStrategy: Repair the smallest failing workflow boundary and repeat both acceptance checks.
tasks.rollbackStrategy: Disable the feature entry point and retain additive data.

globalVerificationStrategy: Run lint, typecheck, unit tests, integration tests, and build
rollbackStrategy: Disable the feature and roll back additive integration points without deleting user data.
risks: Durable production adapters remain outside the standalone runtime
